title: Thrift: Multiple fixes in compact protocol
description:
- Do not interprete the byte after a boolean field header as the field itself.
  Create a generated field from the field type instead.
- Create the generated boolean in the generic dissector only.
  The specific field was already generated in case of boolean type.

Closes #19398

- Correctly check size of method name in Compact Protocol heuristic.
  Prevent false positives that would call the dissector again after reassembly.
- Allow framed dissection to be called with more data than advertized in the frame.

notes.body:
This is the result in the generic dissector:

![generic](/uploads/f7cd624f9fa4811d382b89bf407aeb5c/generic.png)

The result in a specific dissector without showing the field header:

![without_header](/uploads/32ee6d4617062f2261bd704274a59d47/without_header.png)

And the same but showing the field header:

![with_header](/uploads/c04aafceac571b64d942908bdd40f013/with_header.png)

I am not perfectly happy with the additional parameter of `dissect_thrift_field_header()` but I don’t see any other mean to prevent the creation of the generic boolean in the third case (without this, I have both `[Boolean: False]` and `[End Flag: False]` after `Field Header #20` so I hope it is still acceptable.

The last change of the patch is a proper check of the length in compact heuristic and was found while investigating #17934 (for which the Thrift part is fixed by the second to last change in this patch).

There are also a few clean-ups suggested by Clang and a fix to use the right member of the union at line 1695 (`type.binary` instead of `type.compact`).

Fuzzing is in progress since about an hour, no issue so far.
